validated_resources.name: Anthropic frontend-design
validated_resources.license: Apache-2.0 for this skill folder; repository contains other licenses
validated_resources.workflow: New visual direction or complete redesign
validated_resources.integrate: State the audience, subject and single job; record palette, type roles, composition and one signature; critique a rendered result against the brief.
validated_resources.paraphrase: Its current skill derives character from subject matter, gives structure a real information purpose, and asks for deliberate typography and restrained signature motion.
validated_resources.limits: An art-direction brief, not an accessible component implementation or outcome guarantee. Current source should be pinned; whole-repository license assumptions are wrong.
validated_resources.installation: Official README: Claude Code marketplace add anthropics/skills, then install example-skills. Other harnesses can read a compatible local SKILL.md; verify their loader.

validated_resources.name: Impeccable
validated_resources.workflow: Visual critique, typography/density refinement and preserving a design system
validated_resources.integrate: Separate product facts from visual decisions; use Persuade, Operate, Read or Experience mode; inspect actual screenshots, then make bounded fixes.
validated_resources.paraphrase: Operate guidance permits one familiar type family and dense information. It distinguishes hierarchy, rhythm and task affordances from decorative novelty.
validated_resources.limits: Opinionated detectors cannot prove taste. Review installer and hook trust requirements. Do not override an explicit glass/spring brief with generic bans.
validated_resources.installation: Official README: npx impeccable install; project/provider flags available; initialize product context and reload host. Codex skill invocation uses $impeccable; automatic hooks require host trust.

validated_resources.name: Vercel Web Interface Guidelines
validated_resources.license: MIT for web-interface-guidelines source repository; separate agent-skills wrapper has no verified license
validated_resources.workflow: Final interaction and visual consistency review
validated_resources.integrate: Review meaningful files against focus, native semantics, mobile targets, resilient content, interruptible motion and recoverable async states.
validated_resources.paraphrase: Rules connect visual decisions to hit areas, unobscured focus, layout resilience, readable content and honest loading/error feedback.
validated_resources.limits: A living non-exhaustive checklist; some guidance is React/Next-specific. Passing it does not establish aesthetic quality or device certification.
validated_resources.installation: Plain Markdown is agent-readable; official agent-skills wrapper fetches current command.md and returns file:line findings. This report links rules rather than installs a wrapper.

validated_resources.name: shadcn/ui skills and MCP
validated_resources.license: MIT for official source; third-party registries have separate licenses
validated_resources.workflow: Generating real forms, editors and app controls with correct APIs
validated_resources.integrate: Read components.json and shadcn info --json before generation; search registry docs; select and preserve one primitive base.
validated_resources.paraphrase: The skill obtains framework, aliases, installed components and base-library context before composing code. MCP browses, searches and installs registry content.
validated_resources.limits: Copied components still need brand tokens and maintained behavior. React Aria, Base UI and Radix APIs differ; registry results are not automatically trusted.
validated_resources.installation: Official skills docs: pnpm dlx skills add shadcn/ui. MCP configuration is separate and host-specific. July2026 docs add React Aria as a first-class base.

validated_resources.name: React Aria
validated_resources.workflow: Dense editors and source workbenches needing selection, complex forms and internationalization
validated_resources.integrate: Choose unstyled components or hooks; derive custom visual tokens while retaining keyboard/focus/press behavior and labels.
validated_resources.paraphrase: The official site supplies compositional components, contexts and lower-level hooks for custom interactions rather than prescribing a visual theme.
validated_resources.limits: React-specific; application content, contrast and composed workflows still require testing. Hooks add responsibility when overriding default behavior.
validated_resources.installation: Use official install/setup documentation or shadcn aria base in a React app; do not add it to this library core.

validated_resources.name: Base UI
validated_resources.workflow: New React apps with custom brand surfaces and familiar controls
validated_resources.integrate: Use unstyled composable primitives; apply scoped tokens and original composition rather than replacing focus, labels and keyboard behavior.
validated_resources.paraphrase: Base UI does not bundle CSS or require a styling engine; its documentation explains WAI-ARIA patterns, tested environments and a published browser baseline.
validated_resources.limits: React17+ and supported modern browsers; author tests are not our device audit. Unstyled components do not supply visual identity.
validated_resources.installation: Follow official React installation docs; shadcn currently uses Base UI as its default base.

validated_resources.name: Radix Primitives
validated_resources.integrate: Preserve established dialog/menu/tab primitives and add visual character through typography, spacing and semantic tokens.
validated_resources.paraphrase: Radix handles many keyboard and focus details, while explicitly leaving meaningful accessible labels to the application author.
validated_resources.limits: React-specific; do not combine multiple dialog/focus systems casually. No latest GitHub Release returned in this audit; recent repository push is the maintenance signal.
validated_resources.installation: Use existing project dependencies and current official component docs; no migration is justified solely by aesthetic preferences.

validated_resources.name: Carbon for AI
validated_resources.license: Apache-2.0 for Carbon code; IBM branding is separate
validated_resources.workflow: AI suggestions inside familiar data, form and document interfaces
validated_resources.integrate: Mark AI involvement at the result, expose concise explanation on demand, allow human edits and restore the original suggestion.
validated_resources.paraphrase: Carbon reserves its AI appearance for actual AI involvement and describes a label leading to local explanations plus reversible human override.
validated_resources.limits: Adopt the pattern with independent styling. AI labeling alone does not make answers accurate; chat remains preview in the reviewed page.
validated_resources.installation: Use existing Carbon components only in apps already choosing Carbon; otherwise implement the documented pattern independently.

validated_resources.name: Microsoft HAX: Undo automated actions
validated_resources.license: Public research/design reference; no reusable component license asserted
validated_resources.workflow: Correction and recovery after AI changes user work
validated_resources.integrate: Identify the changed output, show how to reverse it, preserve useful prior state and offer global controls if repeated correction costs too much.
validated_resources.paraphrase: The pattern ties undo to a specific automated alteration and warns that repeated correction can be worse than doing the task manually.
validated_resources.limits: Older validated research, not a current component package. Real remote effects may not be reversible; no generic Undo guarantee.
validated_resources.installation: Translate the pattern into task-specific acceptance criteria; no package installation.

maintenance.status: Foundational pattern; original publication2019, not a fresh software-release claim

validated_resources.name: NotebookLM / Gemini Notebook source-grounded chat
validated_resources.license: Proprietary Google app and documentation; interaction reference only
validated_resources.integrate: Show selected source scope beside the question, link each citation to exact source context, and retain citations when saving output.
validated_resources.paraphrase: Google support describes source checkboxes, quote previews and navigation to original context; current documentation labels the product Gemini Notebook.
validated_resources.limits: Documentation observation, not an end-to-end app audit. Mobile limitations and experimental paid desktop agent functions are explicitly noted.
validated_resources.installation: Study interaction architecture; no source code or branded UI copied.

maintenance.status: Official help fetched2026-10-10; naming differs from older NotebookLM links

validated_resources.name: Photoshop Generative Fill
validated_resources.license: Proprietary Adobe app and documentation; interaction reference only
validated_resources.integrate: Make the selected region visible before generation, offer variations, and preserve original content through a reversible editing model.
validated_resources.paraphrase: Adobe describes selecting an area, generating from an optional prompt and choosing a variation as non-destructive editing.
validated_resources.limits: Desktop product reference, not a web component library. Model availability and credits vary; no promise of identical results.
validated_resources.installation: Use the selection/preview/commit pattern with independent implementation.

validated_resources.name: Claude Code operations and checkpointing
validated_resources.license: Product documentation reference; no open-source product license asserted
validated_resources.workflow: Agent operations with visible scope and recoverable local changes
validated_resources.integrate: Show actual task/tool state, provide interruption and permission scope, preview resulting diffs, and label exactly which actions recovery can restore.
validated_resources.paraphrase: Current docs separate interruptions and permissions from file checkpoints; shell, remote and many subagent effects are outside checkpoint restoration.
validated_resources.limits: Checkpointing is not rollback of databases, messages or deployments. This is source-observed behavior, not a tested product session.
validated_resources.installation: Translate control/evidence/recovery patterns into an app; avoid imitating terminal decoration.
